items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Vernon Brown was there from the original band... And the trombones would be Red Ballard and Vernon Brown

ctx.x: The original band, let's see, Hymie Shertzer was there from the original band, and I think Vernon Brown was there from the original band, and Gene Krupa. On the bass was George Duviver, and I think Allen Reuss, the original guitar player, was there. The original bass player with Goodman, of course, was Harry Goodman, Benny's older brother.
